data.long_description:
DAMAC Towers by Paramount Hotels & Resorts is an iconic development in Dubai’s prestigious Burj area. This impressive complex features four towers, with three dedicated to approximately 1,200 luxury serviced hotel apartments and a fourth housing the luxurious Paramount Hotel & Residences. Merging opulent living with Hollywood flair, DAMAC Towers offers an unrivaled lifestyle experience.


  Experience the vibrant Burj area, where the energy of global cities meets world-class shopping, gourmet dining, and exciting entertainment. Located amidst landmark attractions, this prime location provides easy access to the Dubai International Financial Centre, top educational institutions, medical facilities, museums, art galleries, and Dubai International Airport.


  The multi-level plaza that connects the four 270-meter towers offers a wealth of amenities, including specialty dining options, a dine-in cinema, wellness centers, swimming pools, a Kids Studio Club, and The Vault—an exclusive merchandise store by Paramount Hotels & Resorts.


  DAMAC Properties, a leading name in luxury real estate since 2002, boasts a prestigious portfolio of over 20,880 homes and a development pipeline exceeding 44,000 properties. This includes 13,000 hotel rooms, serviced apartments, and hotel villas managed by DAMAC Hotels & Resorts.


  The Paramount Hotel & Residences within DAMAC Towers features over 800 uniquely styled rooms and residences, enhanced by an array of world-class facilities.
